title: Voltmace Delta 14B/1 JOYSTIK driver (© 1983 Custom Video Productions)
notes: Extracted from the Voltmace Delta 14B driver disc (release 1) with oaknut-disc. A *RUN program that loads at &1900 and executes at &1909. Head loader (plain) at &1909 decodes &1A00-&4AFF in place (ROL-1) and starts the BASIC at PAGE=&1C00. The ROL-encoded region holds two 256-byte machine-code driver variants (&1A00, &1B00; both run relocated at &0A00, hooking BYTEV to intercept OSBYTE &81) followed by the tokenised BASIC configuration/demo. The BASIC extends past the decode boundary (page &4B00), so its tail is stored raw ('partly protected').
